mapper.update: UPDATE index_task SET status='PROCESSING', worker_id=#{workerId}, lease_expire_time=DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), started_at=COALESCE(started_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND (status='PENDING' OR (status='RETRY_WAIT' AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))) OR (status='PROCESSING' AND lease_expire_time < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)))

UPDATE index_task SET status=#{status}, failure_code=#{failureCode}, failure_reason=LEFT(#{failureReason},1000), finished_at=CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','DEAD') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE finished_at END, worker_id=NULL, lease_expire_time=NULL WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE index_task SET status='RETRY_WAIT', retry_count=retry_count+1, next_retry_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), failure_code=NULL, failure_reason=NULL, finished_at=NULL WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status IN ('FAILED','DEAD')
